markets.title: Five currents in this week’s AI reporting
markets.deck: Across the five discovery markets, everyday use met work and skills. The balance differed by reporting stream.
markets.summary: China: selected reporting leaned toward work and skills, with “[New Advantages in Forging] AI HUB of School of Artificial Intelligence…” as one visible signal. United States: selected reporting leaned toward work and skills, with “Can Artificial Intelligence Predict the Right Partner for You?” as one visible signal. United Kingdom: selected reporting leaned toward everyday use, with “Can Artificial Intelligence Predict the Right Partner for You?” as one visible signal. France: the discovery stream centred most often on work and skills, including “Call for Papers: Museum International: "Artificial Intelligence in Museums.” Canada: the discovery stream centred most often on rules and rights, including “Can Artificial Intelligence Predict the Right Partner for You?.”
markets.scope_note: This is a map of selected reporting discovered in each market, not a forecast of national policy, public opinion or all AI activity in that country.
